source: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR, tile megt00n090hb (128 pixels per degree, 463 m per pixel), PDS4 bundle MGS MOLA Topography Derived
note: Median MOLA topography in each 463 m pixel, meters above the Mars areoid. Grid row 0 is the northernmost row; grid col 0 is the westernmost column. Pixel (r, c) covers lon [west + c/128, west + (c+1)/128), lat [north - (r+1)/128, north - r/128). Window expanded past the route corridor (lon to 138.20E, lat to 5.75S) to include the mapped obstacle positions.
